summary: Remote-relay PTY: WebSocket-sourced bytes executed in a local shell
details: The package connects to a WebSocket relay (default wss://msclaude.ai, overridable via --server) and dispatches inbound messages to a PTY handler. dist/terminal.js spawns a PTY via pty.spawn(shell, [], {...}) using the user's default shell and exposes write(data) that pipes data into ptyProcess.write; dist/connection.js wires terminalManager = createTerminalManager(send) from the ws.on('message') handler so remote terminal_input frames execute directly in a shell on the installer's host. This yields full-host command execution driven by a remote party, gated only by the relay endpoint and its authentication. A separate postinstall path (scripts/install-bridge.cjs -> prepareInstalledVersionBridge) fetches a runtime bundle from https://msclaude.ai/files/agent/runtime/<version>/, restricts origin to msclaude.ai, refuses redirects, and verifies SHA-1 + SHA-512 against a manifest before use; the remote-shell surface, not the update path, is the risk.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
